{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_data = data[data['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction
n_loyal = len(loyal_data)
n_converted = loyal_data['converted'].sum()
conversion_fraction = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print results
print(f"Number of loyal orders: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal orders: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")"}
